## More 8BitDo Prime Big Deal Days deals

If the Arcade Controller Pro isn’t the type of controller you’re looking for, 8BitDo also has several other products discounted for Prime Big Deal Days. The sale includes the 8BitDo Ultimate 2 Wireless Controller ($49.99), 8BitDo Retro R8 Mouse ($39.99), 8BitDo Ultimate C Bluetooth Controller ($27.99), and 8BitDo Ultimate 2C Wireless Controller ($33.74). ## A compact all-button layout

Compared with 8BitDo’s standard Arcade Controller, the Pro uses smaller buttons and tighter spacing. According to 8BitDo, the arrangement keeps inputs within more natural reach. Whether that translates into better comfort will depend on hand size and playing style, so it’s something we’d want to assess through hands-on testing.

The controller measures 301 × 201 × 16mm and weighs 1,090 grams. Its removable magnetic wrist rest provides additional support and doubles as storage for five included lock caps. [...] The Pro looks most relevant to fighting-game players who already want a leverless controller and expect to use its customization features. Five programmable buttons, on-device settings, hot-swappable switches, and wired or wireless connectivity give them several ways to tailor the setup.

It’s a less obvious choice for someone who is already comfortable with a conventional gamepad or arcade stick and rarely changes controller settings. An all-button directional layout is a different control method, and a screen or extra programmable buttons won’t automatically improve anyone’s results.
